### Action

Action, a JSON object, is a command sent from the Server to the Client to interact with the user's application.

# fundamentals::map

### Map

Map, a JSON object, is a collection of Items sent from the Client to the Server to describe the current landscape of the user application.

<!-- [Bánh Mì compiler message: End of reference from domain: fundamentals::map] -->

# fundamentals::flow

<!-- [Bánh Mì compiler message: This file is auto generated by Bánh Mì, any edit over will be overwritten.] -->

### Flow

Flow represents what Action type does the client accepts.
It allows developers to declare what their application can do.
Developers have to declare these Flows.
Walker provides built-in sets of Flows.

<!-- [Bánh Mì compiler message: End of reference from domain: fundamentals::flow] -->

# fundamentals::item

<!-- [Bánh Mì compiler message: This file is auto generated by Bánh Mì, any edit over will be overwritten.] -->

### Item

Item represents the individual elements that can be interacted with.
When your website run, an Item is an HTML elements in your DOM containing data the your agent needs.
